name: github-skills
description: Templates and style rules for engineering writing on GitHub (pull request descriptions, design docs, bug reports, feature requests, prioritized requests and engineering tickets) and a workflow for stacked pull requests with the gh-stack extension. Use when the user wants to write, fill in or review any of them, add PR and issue templates to a repo, or split work into small dependent PRs.

interface.shortDescription: Write PR descriptions, design docs and GitHub issues from short templates
interface.longDescription: Six templates for the writing that surrounds code on GitHub (PR description, TDD / spec, bug report, prioritized request, feature request, generic engineering ticket) plus the style rules that keep them short and precise. Also installs the blank templates into a repo's .github folder, and includes a step-by-step workflow for stacked pull requests with GitHub's gh-stack extension.
defaultPrompt: Write the PR description for my current branch
File a GitHub issue for the bug I just found
Write a TDD for this feature before I start building
Split these fixes into a stack of small PRs
